newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Merita 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Merita 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 1,273 million markka median forecast for banking group Merita Oy's full-year 1996 operating profit after credit losses:
Operating profit after credit losses EPS
(Profit forecast by 13 analysts, EPS by 11 analysts).
Merita's results are due on Feb 12 around 0900/0700 GMT.
In 1995, Merita had a 491 million markka operating profit after credit losses.
For the banking group's full-year 1997 profit, nine of the 13 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 1,639 million markka (mean 1,831 million) in a 1,400-2,491 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Postipankki and S-E Banken.
